title: World War II
note: Drafted for Prompt 12 (Unit 6). Every lesson is a draft until a person reviews it (content/course/README.md).

listen.explanationKey: Who was president during the Great Depression and World War II?
facts: World War II was fought around the world from 1939 to 1945.
Germany, Italy and Japan, called the Axis Powers, attacked other countries. The Allied Powers, including England, France and Russia, fought against them.
The United States entered World War II after Japan attacked Pearl Harbor, in Hawaii, in 1941.
Franklin Roosevelt was President during the Great Depression and World War II. He was elected four times, more than any other President. After him, the 22nd Amendment limited Presidents to two terms.

listen.explanationKey: Dwight Eisenhower is famous for many things. Name one.
facts: Dwight Eisenhower was a general during World War II. He led the Allied armies in Europe.
He became the 34th President and was President at the end of the Korean War.
He signed the law that built the Interstate highways across the country.
Tip: remember him with three things: a general in World War II, the President when the Korean War ended, and the highways. His nickname was “Ike.”
